evidence_table.claim: Q3 net income was USD4.0bn, adjusted earnings USD3.9bn, and the realised price was USD61.40/BOE, up 32% from USD46.44.
Production was 2.302m BOE/day, down 97,000 reported and 40,000 or 2% after acquisitions and dispositions.
Q3 operating cash was USD7.2bn, capex/investments USD3.1bn and distributions USD3.4bn; 3.4/7.2=47.2%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Results-release cash and distributions section; percentage independently computed.

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash was USD18.924bn, capex/investments USD9.105bn, buybacks USD5.407bn and dividends USD3.064bn; distributions were 44.8% of operating cash and simple cash less capex was USD9.819bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Form 10-Q cash-flow and equity tables; calculations independently recomputed and not labelled company free cash flow.

evidence_table.claim: Total debt was USD23.262bn, debt/capital 26%, total liquidity about USD15.4bn and disposition proceeds USD1.756bn.
